mapper.insert: insert into know_posts( id, tag_id, tags, title, description, latitude, longitude, geo_hash, address, content_url, content_object_key, content_etag, content_size, content_sha256, creator_id, is_top, type, visible, img_urls, video_url, status, created_at, updated_at, publish_time ) values ( cast(#{postId} as bigint), #{tagId}, #{tagsJson}, #{title}, #{description}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{geoHash}, #{address}, #{contentUrl}, #{contentObjectKey}, #{contentEtag}, #{contentSize}, #{contentSha256}, cast(#{creatorId} as bigint), #{isTop}, #{type}, #{visible}, #{imgUrlsJson}, #{videoUrl}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{publishTime} )
mapper.select: select id, tag_id, tags, title, description, latitude, longitude, geo_hash, address, content_url, content_object_key, content_etag, content_size, content_sha256, creator_id, is_top, type, visible, img_urls, video_url, status, created_at, updated_at, publish_time from know_posts where id = cast(#{postId} as bigint)

select p.id, p.creator_id, u.nickname as author_nickname, u.avatar as author_avatar, p.status, p.title, p.description, p.content_url, p.img_urls, p.tags, p.visible, p.type, p.is_top, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.geo_hash, p.address, p.publish_time, p.created_at, p.updated_at from know_posts p join users u on u.id = p.creator_id where p.id = cast(#{postId} as bigint)

select p.id, p.creator_id, u.nickname as author_nickname, u.avatar as author_avatar, p.title, p.description, p.img_urls, p.tags, p.visible, p.publish_time, p.is_top from know_posts p join users u on u.id = p.creator_id where p.status = 'published' and p.visible = 'public' order by p.is_top desc, p.publish_time desc, p.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select p.id, p.creator_id, u.nickname as author_nickname, u.avatar as author_avatar, p.title, p.description, p.img_urls, p.tags, p.visible, p.publish_time, p.is_top from know_posts p join users u on u.id = p.creator_id where p.creator_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and p.status = 'published' order by p.is_top desc, p.publish_time desc, p.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select exists( select 1 from following where from_user_id = cast(#{viewerId} as bigint) and to_user_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and rel_status = 1 )
mapper.update: update know_posts set status = #{status}, content_url = #{contentUrl}, content_object_key = #{objectKey}, content_etag = #{etag}, content_size = #{size}, content_sha256 = #{sha256}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = cast(#{postId} as bigint) and creator_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and status in ('draft', 'content_confirmed', 'metadata_completed')

update know_posts set status = #{status}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, tags = #{tagsJson}, img_urls = #{imgUrlsJson}, is_top = #{isTop}, visible = #{visible}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, geo_hash = #{geoHash}, address = #{address}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = cast(#{postId} as bigint) and creator_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and status in ('draft', 'content_confirmed', 'metadata_completed')

update know_posts set visible = #{visibility}, status = #{status}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = cast(#{postId} as bigint) and creator_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and status in ('draft', 'content_confirmed', 'metadata_completed')
update know_posts set is_top = #{isTop}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = cast(#{postId} as bigint) and creator_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and status = 'published'
update know_posts set visible = #{visible}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = cast(#{postId} as bigint) and creator_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and status = 'published'
update know_posts set status = 'deleted', updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = cast(#{postId} as bigint) and creator_id = cast(#{creatorId} as bigint) and status <> 'deleted'
mapper.insert: insert into outbox( id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, created_at, published_at ) values ( cast(#{id} as bigint), #{aggregateType}, cast(#{aggregateId} as bigint), #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{createdAt}, null )
mapper.select: select id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, created_at from outbox where aggregate_type = 'post' and status in ('pending', 'failed') order by created_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update outbox set status = 'published', published_at = #{publishedAt}, last_error = null where id = cast(#{eventId} as bigint) and status in ('pending', 'failed')
update outbox set status = 'failed', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError} where id = cast(#{eventId} as bigint) and status in ('pending', 'failed')
